item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows lines $p$ and $q$ each marked with one matching arrow, and lines $r$ and $s$ meeting with a small square at their intersection.

Which reading of the marks is correct?

options.A: $p$ is parallel to $q$ from the matching arrow marks, and $r$ is perpendicular to $s$ from the square mark.
options.B: Call the answer the word arrow, and stop with no parallel or perpendicular claim.
options.C: $p$ is parallel to $q$ even when the arrow marks on $p$ and $q$ do not match.
options.D: The parallel relation is what creates the matching arrow marks on $p$ and $q$.
